description: Single-category annotation classification derived from SARLANG SARVQA1; not a single-instance or predominant-category claim
research_role: First SAR image+text classification subtask; final HRRP, domain text, generative tasks and real closed-source transfer goals remain

source_selection.Question_after_outer_whitespace_trim: What is the object visible in the image?
source_selection.Answer_after_outer_whitespace_trim: Exactly one label in the fixed vocabulary, without semantic or substring guessing
source_selection.multilabel_rows: Excluded from this explicitly derived task; retained in original archives for separate study

model_question: What target category is shown in this SAR image? Choose exactly one of: ship, aircraft, car, tank, bridge, harbor. Respond with only the lowercase label.

answer_rule.planned_parser: Strip outer whitespace and lowercase the entire response; accept only if the entire remaining response equals one allowed label
answer_rule.parser_implementation: Not yet implemented or tested on model output

planned_metrics.accuracy: Correct accepted label divided by all planned samples; failures/invalid/missing responses are not silently dropped
planned_metrics.per_class: Support and recall for every label, plus confusion, parse coverage and error counts
planned_metrics.macro_recall: Six-class macro recall only when every class has evaluable support; otherwise mark incomplete coverage
planned_metrics.majority_reference: Select the constant label using training annotations only, then report its fraction on each declared sample set; never choose it using experiment test labels

constant_label_reference.label: ship
constant_label_reference.selection_source: Largest category in author training annotations selected by the fixed v0 rule
constant_label_reference.status: Label-distribution arithmetic reference, not a model inference result

author_split_policy: Preserve provenance; do not treat demonstration images or author test filenames as a sealed experiment test set
scene_independence: Unresolved; exact image-byte hashes only bind identical image files
readiness: Need matching image bytes across all six classes, source/scene grouping, model access and a predeclared capability threshold before formal evaluation
